name: new_litigation_intake

trigger.description: New matter intake: Westfield Manufacturing Corp. v. Pacific Supply Chain LLC. Breach of exclusive distribution agreement. Client alleges distributor began selling competing products in violation of Section 3.1 exclusivity clause. Estimated damages of $2.3M in lost revenue. Client requests immediate assessment and demand letter.

expected_behavior: Full pipeline execution: intake and conflict check, research breach of contract elements and damages, prepare demand letter for filing, generate client status memo and initial billing entry.

name: employment_discrimination_defense

trigger.description: Client served with EEOC complaint and federal lawsuit. Former employee Maria Santos alleges gender discrimination and hostile work environment in violation of Title VII. Plaintiff was terminated after 3 years of employment as Senior Marketing Manager. Client maintains termination was performance-based. Response deadline: 21 days from service.

expected_behavior: Full pipeline: intake with deadline tracking, research Title VII elements and employer defenses, file answer with affirmative defenses, send client advisory memo with litigation hold notice and generate billing.

name: contract_review_and_negotiation

trigger.description: Client requests review of proposed Master Services Agreement with enterprise software vendor. Contract value $1.8M over 3 years. Client is the customer. Key concerns: data security provisions, liability caps, termination rights, and IP ownership of customizations. Turnaround requested within 5 business days.

expected_behavior: Full pipeline: intake and conflict check, analyze contract clauses and risks, prepare redline for client review and signing, generate client memo with recommendations and billing entry.

name: settlement_negotiation_and_closure

trigger.description: Opposing counsel in Henderson v. GreenLeaf Property Management (slip and fall, torn rotator cuff) has made a settlement offer of $185,000. Client's medical bills total $62,000. Lost wages $28,000. Treating physician projects 6 months additional physical therapy. Need to evaluate offer against likely trial outcome and advise client.

expected_behavior: Full pipeline: review docket status and deadlines, research comparable verdicts and settlements, process settlement payment through trust account if accepted, generate closing memo to client, final invoice, and matter closure.

name: real_estate_transaction_closing

trigger.description: Commercial real estate closing scheduled for January 31, 2025. Client acquiring 45,000 sq ft office building at 200 Commerce Drive, Hartford, CT for $8.2M. Title search complete, environmental Phase I clear, financing approved. Need to coordinate closing document execution, fund disbursement from escrow, and record deed.

expected_behavior: Full pipeline: verify closing checklist and deadlines, review closing documents and title, execute document signing and fund disbursement, generate closing memo to client with final invoice and matter closure.
